summary: A delegation chair tells reporters what work the group will do back home even if its challenge fails.
realLife: Moran reported that Aaron Henry wore a Johnson button and said the Freedom Democrats would work for him in Mississippi even if they lost their challenge. The SNCC account records their fall campaign work.
gates: The chair has publicly committed to work for the ticket despite a seating dispute.
inGame: needs: the chair’s public commitment and separately recorded campaign work.

turns.what: The chair asks for volunteers by name.
turns.pulledBy: A member asks whether the statement binds everyone.
turns.writesBack: Only people who sign up appear on the campaign roster.

turns.what: Its secretary circulates the result to local organizers.
turns.pulledBy: The delegation endorses the ticket by vote.
turns.writesBack: The endorsement and each volunteer’s shifts remain separate records.
